usage.callShape: GET https://api.strale.io/x402/customs-duty-lookup?hs_code=<HS>&origin_country=<ISO2>&destination_country=<ISO2> (query params; hs_code required, the two country params optional)
usage.outputShape: body.duty_rate, body.duty_type, body.vat_rate, body.anti_dumping, body.preferential_rates[], body.additional_duties[], body.description, body.notes (human-readable status). Provenance at body._meta.provenance, settlement at body._meta.payment.settlement_id
quirks: hs_code is a required QUERY parameter — without it the call would 422; pass it in the URL query string, not a body (this is a GET).
origin_country/destination_country are optional ISO-2 codes (e.g. CN, DE).

Endpoint scrapes ec.europa.eu/taric live. For some HS codes the upstream TARIC page returns no loaded tariff data, so duty_rate/vat_rate/duty_type/description come back null with an explanatory body.notes string. A null result is NOT an endpoint error — payment still settles and a valid 200 JSON is returned. Read body.notes to understand why fields are null and retry with a different/more specific HS code if needed.
Fixed price ~$0.216 USDC on Base per call despite registry priceDisplay 'Varies'.
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.strale.io/x402/customs-duty-lookup with hs_code as a required query parameter (e.g. ?hs_code=847130), plus optional origin_country and destination_country ISO-2 codes. Payment is x402 USDC on Base, ~$0.216 per call, synchronous (200 returns the answer directly). Read duty info from body.duty_rate, body.duty_type, body.vat_rate, body.anti_dumping, and body.preferential_rates[]. If those are null, read body.notes — the upstream EU TARIC page sometimes returns no tariff data for a given HS code; that is a data-source gap, not a failure, so try a different HS code rather than retrying the same one.
